newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Command shares in active trade.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Command shares in active trade.

text.p: Shares in takeover target Command Petroleum Holdings NL saw active trade on Wednesday with over 14.01 million shares or about 4.3 percent of its capital traded.

The bulk of the trade was in a crossing of 9.5 million shares through SBC Warburg at a price of A$1.13 per share. UK-based Cairn Energy Plc is offering A$1.10 cash per Command share or two Cairn shares for every 13 Command shares.

A Command spokesman said the company was unaware of the identity of the parties to the transaction but suggested U.K. institutional investors may have been in an arbitrage play, given the scrip option contained in the bid.
Cairn Energy Australia Pty Ltd, the takeover vehicle of Cairn Energy Plc, said earlier on Wednesday it had an entitlement to 110.44 million Command shares or about 34.3 percent of Comand's capital.
